annotation.interpretation_a: The term "new server address" refers to any address that differs from the current server address, so the client should discard packets from any such address.
annotation.interpretation_b: The term "new server address" refers only to an address that has never been seen before, so the client may accept packets from a previously seen address that is not indicated by the preferred_address parameter.
annotation.justification: The clause does not define "new server address", allowing two materially different reasonable interpretations of when packets should be discarded.
